title: Updated invoice — immediate review required

left.subject: Updated invoice — immediate review required
left.bodyHtml:
Hi Mara,

The vendor's updated invoice could not be processed.

Please review the attached PDF and approve the updated amount.

Failure to approve in time may delay month-end closing.

right.subject: Vendor invoice posted in Finance Portal
right.bodyHtml:
Hi Mara,

The approved vendor invoice has been posted.

View it through the Finance Portal under "Invoices."

No sensitive documents are distributed by email.

explainPoints: Subtle domain look-alike: Email A uses "nexatrustdocs.com" which appears official but differs from the real "nexatrust.com" domain in email B.
Urgency & consequence framing: Email A uses threat of delayed month-end closing to pressure quick action, while email B is informational.
Attachment lure: Email A mentions a PDF attachment for malware delivery. Email B's legit policy states "No sensitive documents are distributed by email" and directs to the Finance Portal.
